answer.rationale: Primary lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew and only one action this cycle, so defer or add_second_source would leave the 94% loaded, zero-buffer line uncovered. Switching to the qualifying low-cost quote would hit the 18% spend cut and is supported by c2, but it would raise delivery risk on a no-buffer line and so fails the stated constraint unless the archived c2 record shows onboarding truly carried no supply risk. Incumbent renewal (c1) protects continuity but does not minimize TCO. Using the competing quote to renegotiate the expiring incumbent contract (c4) is the only single move that can pursue the cost mandate without deliberately increasing delivery risk. Whether the incumbent will actually match ~18% is unknown; not locking a multi-year broad commitment.
